messages:
Ana: FYI partner wants a lightweight onboarding for an open 3B model into the marketplace. They prefer 'hosted' but also want an option for a 'download voucher' for enterprise SI installs. Need to confirm license and any dataset restrictions. @Tom @Priya @Marco
Tom: thx Ana. main legal concern: dataset provenance + attribution. If any training data restricts commercial downstream, download option is off the table. can we get a provenance statement?
Priya: Product POV: hosted gives us telemetry + easier billing; download means we must remove server-side telemetry and rely on entitlement vouchers. Also need perf numbers for q4_0/q8.
Marco: Eng: For host flow we need signed artifact + smoke test container. Must include checksums and runtime pinned to our inference runtime version. For download flow we need an installer with an integrity check. Example manifest below:
```
{
  "id": "open-3b-vendor-2026",
  "ver": "2026-03-25",
  "files": ["open-3b-fp16.bin", "open-3b-q4_0.bin"],
  "sha256": {"fp16":"<sha256>","q4_0":"<sha256>"},
  "license": "vendor-syndication-0.9"
}
```
LegalBot: Reminder: upload NDAs and check export control appendix.
Ana: action items: Tom to request provenance + license string; Marco to provide artifact template; Priya to draft hosting vs download product note. follow-up Thurs.
Tom: noted. I'll escalate if dataset provenance is unclear.
Priya: will draft perf template and share before Thurs.
Marco: will push artifact template to repo and link.
Ana: thanks all.
